title: Counting Marlowe Rewards Points by Tier: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Cancellation Relief Training Note
content:
**Rule.** The points relief on a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order cancellation charge rests on the Marlowe Rewards points counted over the last 12 months. How they are counted depends on the customer's tier:

| Marlowe Rewards membership | Entries counted | Date that places an entry in the 12 months | Points still pending |
|---|---|---|---|
| Active Platinum, Icon or Atelier | Every earning entry and every bonus entry | Its posting date | Included |
| Active Gold or Silver | Every earning entry | Its posting date | Included |
| Every other customer | Every earning entry | The date its points became available | Left out |

**Questions and answers**

*What makes points "pending"?*
They have been posted but have not yet become available. Counting by posting date takes them in. Counting by the date points became available leaves them out until they become available.

*Are bonus entries counted for a Gold member?*
No. For Gold and Silver, only earning entries are counted.

*How is a Marlowe Rewards Member counted?*
Under "every other customer": earning entries by the date their points became available.

**Illustration.** A hypothetical ledger, with today as the reference date:

| Entry | Points | Posted | Became or becomes available |
|---|---|---|---|
| Earning | 3000 | 3 months ago | 2 months ago |
| Earning | 1500 | 10 days ago | In 20 days (pending) |
| Bonus | 800 | 1 month ago | 1 month ago |
| Earning | 600 | 13 months ago | 11 months ago |

| Membership | Points counted |
|---|---|
| Active Platinum | 3000 plus 1500 plus 800, which is 5300 |
| Active Gold | 3000 plus 1500, which is 4500 |
| Active Member tier | 3000 plus 600, which is 3600 |
